page.overview:
Who is Beach Kaiju?

Earth|goals=Destroy anything and everything (failed) Kill Nolan (failed)|status=Deceased|fate=Bisected in half by Nolan Grayson|only appearance=3x02 "A Deal With The Devil"|died=Thragg Era 2002 Earth}} The Beach Kaiju is a minor antagonist that appeared in a flashback in Season 3 of Invincible

The Beach Kaiju is a multicolored bluish green monster, with the design resembling a crab and spider.

In the 2000s, this Kaiju emerges from the shores of a beach in possibly Miami, Florida, where Nolan discovered it.

Nolan fought fiercely against the monster, and his fight caught the attention of the GDA who discovered the two, Nolan had then cut the beast in half as his blood was covered all over Nolan's uniform by the time Cecil arrived.
